gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: Exact ZIPs ran with zero invalid actions; measured import/create, reset, act latency, and RSS were within local limits.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: Opening launch activated 120 times, early steering 103 times, bend braking 97 times, and straight boost zero times.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Both exact ZIPs finished 12/12 reused diagnostic cells; candidate median 23.88 s versus 23.85 s control, with fewer collisions. Reused cells are not independent promotion evidence, so new tune is required.
